model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е кръгова, която представя разпределението на категориите герои в набора от данни RolePlayPref, състоящ се от общо 13 категории. Има 13 сектора, които представляват различните типове герои: Movie Characters, Comic Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters, Musicians, Actors, Athletes, Scientists, Writers, Influencers, Virtual Characters и Real Characters. Секторите не са със специфични цветове, изключение прави сектора Movie Characters, който е оцветен в тъмночервено. Секторите са подредени във видимо намаляващ ред на големината им. Големината на всеки сектор представлява дела на съответния тип герой в набора от данни, като Movie Characters представляват 6.2%, Comic Characters – 14.8%, Teleplay Characters – 10.8%, Novel Characters – 10.3%, Game Characters – 8.7% и останалите категории представляват пропорционално по-малък дял. Диаграмата включва легенда, която идентифицира всяка категория. Във всеки сектор са показани процентите, представляващи дела на съответния тип герой.
model_annotations.English: Figure 3 presents the distribution of character types within the RolePlayPref dataset, comprising 16,888 dialogues. The pie chart displays 13 distinct categories, visually organized in a clockwise direction starting with the largest segment. These categories are Movie Characters (light blue, approximately 26.2%), Comic Characters (yellow, approximately 16.8%), Virtual Characters (green, approximately 11.4%), Novel Characters (dark blue, approximately 9.5%), Real Characters (purple, approximately 7.7%), Teleplay Characters (orange, approximately 6.2%), Musicians (grey, approximately 5.6%), Game Characters (slightly darker grey, approximately 5.2%), Scientists (light green, approximately 3.6%), Authors/Artists (beige, approximately 3.3%), Influencers (brown, approximately 2.6%), Writers (light orange, approximately 1.8%), and Actors (light purple, approximately 1.1%). The chart includes a legend identifying each category by color and name, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. No slices are visually emphasized through techniques like exploding or bolding.
model_annotations.German: Figure 3 is a circular diagram depicting the distribution of 13 character role-play categories within a dataset. The diagram is composed of 13 segments, each representing a different category: Comic Characters, Movie Characters, Virtual Characters, Real Characters, Teleplay Characters, Novel Characters, Game Characters, Scientists, Athletes, Musicians, Actors, Writers, and Influencers. The segments are coloured in varying shades of blue and purple, with Comic Characters being a lighter shade compared to others. There are no explicit percentage values shown within the segments; however, the segments appear to be ordered by size, starting with Comic Characters as the largest, followed by Movie Characters, and then Virtual Characters. The diagram includes a legend identifying each category with its respective colour. The segments do not appear to be visually offset or highlighted in any particular way.
